author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using a Butter Cutter diamond blade to cut the tile. Then I polish it with my grinder and chamfer cone. This method is also great for cutting tiles around shower valves. For more tile floor tips, check out my Bathroom Floors Guide at https://homerepairtutor.com/guides/bathroom-floors/
